description: Root object representing a full floor plan including area layout and space-level geometry.

floor_plan.description: Container for the entire layout, including area-level layout and detailed area definitions.

total_areas.description: Total number of areas in the floor plan. Must match the number of objects in the areas array.

area_layout.description: Defines the spatial arrangement of areas within the floor plan using a row-based layout.

rows.description: List of rows describing how areas are visually arranged in the floor plan.

row_index.description: 1-based index indicating the vertical position of the row.

areas.description: Ordered list of area_ids that appear in this row from left to right.
List of all areas in the floor plan. Each area defines its own layout and space structure.

area_id.description: Unique identifier of the area. Must be referenced by area_layout.

area_note.description: Optional descriptive note for the area (e.g., 'ISO', 'Public View').

layout.description: Defines the internal layout of spaces within the area using a row-based structure.

rows.description: List of rows defining how spaces are arranged within the area.

row_index.description: 1-based index of the row within the area.

spaces.description: Ordered list of space IDs that appear in this row from left to right.
Defines all individual and merged spaces within the area, including their position and size.

row.description: Row index where the space is located within the area layout.

col_start.description: Starting column position (1-based index) of the space within its row.

col_span.description: Number of columns the space spans horizontally. Used to represent merged or wide spaces.

unit_count.description: Optional. Number of logical units represented by this space. Example: '9-10' has unit_count = 2.

note.description: Optional descriptive label for the space.

groups.description: Optional grouping of consecutive spaces representing logical categories or shared attributes.

start.description: Starting space number in the group range.

end.description: Ending space number in the group range.

note.description: Optional descriptive label for the group.
